title: Answer: build mechanism models of the illusion and test them on reports

statements.text: What can be checked is a model of the mechanisms that produce phenomenal reports and judgments, built from cognitive science and neuroscience and tested by heterophenomenological experiments. Evidence such as change blindness, where people misjudge their own experience, bears on it, and design sketches such as the emancipated drone show what a consumer of the representations must do.

sources.quote: drawing on evidence from across the cognitive sciences
evidence for the grand illusion view, such as the existence of change blindness, does lend support to illusionism
